description: This file defines a class 'ADODB2_sapdb' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides methods for data type mappings and SQL generation specific to SAPDB database, including functions for altering tables and columns.

classes.name: ADODB2_sapdb
classes.description: A class providing SAPDB-specific database dialect and schema alteration methods, extending for use within an ADODB data abstraction layer.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the database-specific SQL data type based on a given meta code.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Determines the ADODB data type code based on a given database type, optional length, and field object.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions, including NOT NULL, default, unsigned, and other constraints.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs an SQL statement for adding columns to a specified table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs an SQL statement for modifying columns in a specified table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Constructs an SQL statement to drop columns from a specified table.
